title: NEAR account retention (mainnet) — active again after day 30?

source.name: NEAR mainnet, named accounts created through the `near` registrar
source.population: every `*.near` account whose CREATE_ACCOUNT receipt (predecessor `near`) succeeded with block_date between creation_window.from and creation_window.to (UTC) AND that initiated at least one action (receipt predecessor = the account, directly or through a relayer) within its first 7 days; accounts that never acted in week 1 (85% of registrar creations in this period, mostly 6,308 accounts mass-created by one signer) are out of scope
source.activity_definition: an action whose receipt_predecessor_account_id is the account: a transaction it signed, or a meta-transaction (NEP-366) it sent through a relayer that signed for it
source.license: public blockchain data; the Lakehouse is published by NEAR free of charge

meaning.1: retained: the account signed at least one transaction between day 30 and day 90 after creation (positive class)
meaning.0: churned: no transaction signed in that window

label.definition: count(receipt_actions where receipt_predecessor_account_id = account and t0 + 30d <= block_timestamp < t0 + 90d) >= 1, t0 = creation block timestamp
label.sampling: all rows are a stratified sample of the population: positives and negatives are drawn so that the sample holds about 40% positives (the population rate is lower and is reported in population.json); the model's log-odds are therefore relative to that enriched prior

features_use_only: the creation receipt and the first 7 days after creation (t0 <= block_timestamp < t0 + 7d); nothing from day 7 on
integer_rule: every feature is an integer that fits i16; counts and amounts are clipped at 32767; NEAR amounts are in milliNEAR (1 mNEAR = 10^21 yocto), rounded down

features.name: created_hour_utc
features.meaning: UTC hour of the creation block

features.name: created_weekday
features.meaning: day of week of the creation block, 0 = Monday

features.name: creator_class
features.meaning: who signed the create_account call on the registrar; codes are the rank of the signer among the most frequent creators in the population, see creator_codes in population.json; the last code means 'any other account'

features.name: name_len
features.meaning: length of the account name without the .near suffix

features.name: name_digits
features.meaning: number of digit characters in the name

features.name: name_has_separator
features.meaning: 1 if the name contains '-' or '_'

features.name: initial_deposit_mnear
features.meaning: NEAR transferred to the account in its creation receipt

features.name: tx_signed_7d
features.meaning: actions the account initiated in the first 7 days, counted per receipt (signed itself or via a relayer)

features.name: active_days_7d
features.meaning: distinct UTC dates with at least one initiated action in the first 7 days (a 7-day window can touch 8 UTC dates)

features.name: days_to_first_tx
features.meaning: whole days from creation to the first action the account initiated (always within the window, by the population definition)

features.name: unique_receivers_7d
features.meaning: distinct receiver accounts of the initiated actions

features.name: fn_calls_7d
features.meaning: FUNCTION_CALL actions the account initiated

features.name: distinct_methods_7d
features.meaning: distinct method names among those function calls

features.name: distinct_contracts_7d
features.meaning: distinct receiver contracts among those function calls

features.name: transfers_out_7d
features.meaning: TRANSFER actions the account initiated

features.name: near_out_7d_mnear
features.meaning: sum of those outgoing transfers

features.name: near_in_7d_mnear
features.meaning: sum of TRANSFER actions received after the creation receipt

features.name: tx_received_7d
features.meaning: receipts from other accounts (not refunds) whose receiver is the account, after the creation receipt

features.name: keys_added_7d
features.meaning: ADD_KEY actions on the account after the creation receipt (wallet or dapp logins)

features.name: deployed_contract_7d
features.meaning: 1 if a DEPLOY_CONTRACT action targeted the account

features.name: staked_7d
features.meaning: 1 if the account signed a STAKE action or a function call to a staking pool (*.poolv1.near, *.pool.near, meta-pool.near, linear-protocol.near)

features.name: touched_defi_7d
features.meaning: 1 if the account signed a function call to v2.ref-finance.near, dclv2.ref-labs.near, wrap.near, contract.main.burrow.near, intents.near or aurora

split.method: deterministic: rows ordered by FARM_FINGERPRINT(account_id) in BigQuery, then two-stage stratified train_test_split on label
split.note: public rows name the account so anyone can recheck a feature against the chain; private rows are feature vectors only, their account ids are never published

metric.primary: balanced_accuracy_bps = (TPR_bps + TNR_bps) / 2, integer division, positive class = retained
